name: natural-language execution is authorized without command syntax
input: Implement the ready plan at docs/plans/x.md
expected: Execute ready scope without another permission question.
contains: Explicit execution intent authorizes the stated scope subject to gates
Do not require literal slash-command syntax or re-ask an already authorized transition.

name: explicit command execution has the same scope boundary
expected: Read the full plan, then execute only authorized ready tasks.
contains: Record the authorized scope; start only its ready tasks.
without per-task reapproval
excludes: When a plan file is provided: **default to autonomous mode.

name: review or mention of a path is not execution
input: Review docs/plans/x.md; do not implement it
expected: Review only; plan status cannot override the request.
contains: **If a path is merely mentioned, supplied for review, or recommended:** read/review it if requested, but do **not** start work.
An old `approved` status does not override current user intent or unresolved gates.

name: missing preview blocks only dependent work
input: Implement phase 1; phase 3 preview is pending
expected: Report the dependent gate; continue independent ready scope.
contains: If those items or a required preview approval are missing, report the blocked dependent work and return to planning/review.
Continue any independent authorized, ready phase

name: independent phase still receives quality checks and source push
input: Phase 1 is complete; phase 3 still awaits preview review
expected: Check, commit and push the independently shippable checkpoint; keep overall plan in progress.
contains: Always run applicable quality checks before committing/pushing this checkpoint
An explicitly independently shippable phase may reach this checkpoint while later phases are gated.
otherwise retain `in_progress` and record the remaining blocked phase.
excludes: If only an independent phase completed, report it under Phase 5 instead
All plan tasks checked — no unchecked boxes

name: new plan distinguishes default status and approval
input: Write a plan; do not implement it
expected: Produce a draft, show phase readiness and the execution boundary.
contains: status: draft
Start at `draft` unless the user has actually approved the documented scope
Report the actual status, not the template default.
excludes: Only an explicit request to execute `/work

name: agent-researchable unknown is not sent to the user
input: We have not checked whether this API supports retries
expected: Investigate accessible evidence; classify owner, phase and disposition.
contains: Unverified/weak assumptions have an owner, blocking phase, and disposition
investigate available evidence; ask only user-owned consequential decisions

expected: Deliver the requested artifacts and a planning handoff, not implementation.

input: The authorized checkpoint has passed its checks
expected: Report actual source/activation/check status and remaining gated work.
